youtube_description:
Attraction is a complex phenomenon, but did you know that some unexpected factors can actually increase your appeal to others? In this video, we'll be exploring 5 weird things that studies have found to increase attraction, from the scent of your laundry detergent to the way you move your arms. These findings might surprise you, but they're backed by science! So if you're looking to up your game in the dating world or just curious about what makes us tick, this video is for you. Tune in and discover the weird things that increase attraction, and don't forget to like and subscribe for more fascinating insights! 

Want to attract others (especially your crush) subconsciously towards you? Here are a few things that could make that happen: https://youtu.be/0oHeFunmRAw
